notes_for_editor: Standing is confirmed by firelookout.org. The 1958 report and 1964 NGS note are quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, which credits the 1958 piece to the Kingsport News; the original article was not checked. The NGS station is BIG KNOB, VA/SCOTT. The 1964 note also measures the station mark from the tower's legs (10.3 ft from the southeast leg, 4.8 ft from the northeast leg), so the mark sits on this tower's site; the note still gives no construction date. The 1930/1933 date is on the survey mark (a standard disk set in bedrock), not the tower, and nothing in the sources dates the tower from it. Do not use the 1964 access description (locked gate, 3.25-mile trail) for visits; it is historic and the tower is private. High Knob (Wise/Scott counties) is a different tower. No design, height, or build date in any source read. Fact-check 2026-10-08: 'earliest record' became 'earliest dated record of the tower in these sources'; the claim that nothing ties the survey mark to the tower was removed because the 1964 note does tie them by measurement; the Register footnote was removed from the advice sentence; the access and survey-mark quotes were added as evidence.
